payload.aggregation: Average five downstream seeds within each upstream seed; equal-weight mean and sample SD (ddof=1) across upstream seeds 1-5.
payload.fit_definition: Equal-weight quadratic OLS in t=(A-75)/25; descriptive only.
payload.refiner_selection_note: F1, F2_origin, F2_vertex and F3. No missing seed or allocation is imputed.
payload.input_refiner_baseline_note: F2 absolute rejections use their actual paired-regenerated-cache summaries without rescaling. Retain the original upstream curve; paired baseline differences are audited.
payload.reference_definition: 100/0 Transformer mean over upstream seeds 1-5 at 122k/142k/164k/188k parameters. Shorter, denser dashes encode larger parameter counts.
payload.caption: Six established working points at total 3M. Upstream seeds 1-5; each refiner group averages five downstream seeds. Error bars show upstream-seed sample SD; upstream fits are descriptive. Top row matches the existing light-background figure. F2 paired-cache differences are audited; no rescaling or imputation.
